Static renderer called from CustomUnit draw passes with (drawOverBody, drawUnderAllUnits) booleans; it filters LegOrArmTemplate.drawOverBody/drawUnderAllUnits, applies hidden/alpha checks, draws shadows, feet/end images, middle/leg images, and optional link lines.
CustomUnit.ensureLegRuntimeStates writes the leg/arm slot index into LegRuntimeState.a after allocating each runtime state.

LegAnimationBehavior update writes current foot Y offset; CustomUnit save/load serializes it and drawLegLayer renders at unit.ep + footY.

When a leg starts moving, update code increments LegRuntimeState.e until it reaches LegOrArmTemplate.moveWarmUp before raising/lowering the foot.

Update code sets this when unit movement/rotation or reset changes leg target/current state and uses it as the fast-path gate before recomputing target placement.

CustomUnit.ensureLegRuntimeStates copies LegOrArmTemplate.alpha into LegRuntimeState.s; drawLegLayer multiplies render alpha by this runtime value.

CustomUnit.du creates/resizes dT to match metadata.legOrArmTemplates, initializes LegRuntimeState.index and alpha from each template, snapshots unit position/height/dir, then refreshes leg runtime states.
CustomUnit.dv directly invokes LegAnimationBehavior.instance.onLateUpdate(this, 0) to recompute leg runtime placement immediately after allocation or falling reset.
